question_roman: 12 cm lambe aur 8 cm chaure mustateel ka muheet kya hai?
explanation_ur: محیط = 2 × (لمبائی + چوڑائی) = 2 × (12 + 8) = 40 cm۔
explanation_roman: Muheet = 2 x (lambai + chaurai) = 2 x (12 + 8) = 40 cm.
subject: Past-Paper Topics
question: What is the perimeter of a rectangle 12 cm long and 8 cm wide?
explanation: Perimeter = 2 x (length + width) = 2 x (12 + 8) = 40 cm.
explanationEn: Perimeter = 2 x (length + width) = 2 x (12 + 8) = 40 cm.

question_ur: وہ جملہ منتخب کریں جس میں شرطی انداز (subjunctive mood) درست استعمال ہوا ہو۔
question_roman: Woh jumla muntakhab karen jis mein sharti andaz (subjunctive mood) durust istemal hua ho.
options_ur: If I was rich, I would travel the world.
If I am rich, I would travel the world.
If I were rich, I would travel the world.
If I will be rich, I would travel the world.
options_roman: If I was rich, I would travel the world.
If I am rich, I would travel the world.
If I were rich, I would travel the world.
If I will be rich, I would travel the world.
explanation_ur: غیر حقیقی موجودہ خواہش کے لیے if کے بعد were کی شرطی صورت استعمال ہوتی ہے، was یا am یا will be نہیں۔
explanation_roman: Ghair haqeeqi maujooda khwahish ke liye if ke baad were ki sharti soorat istemal hoti hai, was ya am ya will be nahi.
subject: Past-Paper Topics
question: Choose the sentence that uses the subjunctive mood correctly.
options: If I was rich, I would travel the world.
If I am rich, I would travel the world.
If I were rich, I would travel the world.
If I will be rich, I would travel the world.
explanation: After 'if' the subjunctive form 'were' is used for an unreal present wish, not 'was', 'am' or 'will be'.
explanationEn: After 'if' the subjunctive form 'were' is used for an unreal present wish, not 'was', 'am' or 'will be'.

question_ur: سیدھی لکیر 3x + 4y = 12 کی ڈھلان کیا ہے؟
question_roman: Seedhi lakeer 3x + 4y = 12 ki dhalan kya hai?
explanation_ur: لکیر کو ڈھلان کی صورت میں لکھنے سے 4y = -3x + 12 حاصل ہوتا ہے، یعنی y = (-3/4)x + 3، اس لیے ڈھلان -3/4 ہے۔
explanation_roman: Lakeer ko dhalan ki soorat mein likhnay se 4y = -3x + 12 hasil hota hai, yani y = (-3/4)x + 3, is liye dhalan -3/4 hai.
subject: Past-Paper Topics
question: What is the slope of the straight line 3x + 4y = 12?
explanation: Writing the line in slope-intercept form gives 4y = -3x + 12, so y = (-3/4)x + 3, and the slope is -3/4.
explanationEn: Writing the line in slope-intercept form gives 4y = -3x + 12, so y = (-3/4)x + 3, and the slope is -3/4.
